item.title: Cialis is an erectile dysfunction drug. Could it also help you live longer?
item.description: In some wellness circles, tadalafil is promoted as a longevity drug. There is evidence showing a link between it and a lower risk of death in men, but there are no well-controlled trials in humans.
item.content:encoded: In some wellness circles, tadalafil is promoted as a longevity drug. There is evidence showing a link between it and a lower risk of death in men, but there are no well-controlled trials in humans.

item.title: The drug lenacapavir is a mighty weapon against HIV. Its rollout gets mixed reviews
item.description: It's a twice-a-year injection that is remarkably effective in preventing an HIV infection. Distribution is starting. But questions are being raised about getting it to the areas that need it most.

item.title: Boston-area trial draws attention to post-partum psychosis
item.description: A mom is on trial for killing her children. Her defense says she had post-partum psychosis. Psychiatrists hope the case brings attention to the need for better diagnosis and treatment for the illness.
